title: fix(raycast): gate cleanup-at-send on the page's AI master toggle
body:
## Summary

Fixes a logical bug in b6b9a80: `raycast/send-to-iterm.sh` and `raycast/send-to-vscode.sh` were calling `voiceitt-transform` (and pasting LLM-cleaned text) unconditionally, even when the page's AI master toggle was OFF. That toggle is supposed to be a hard opt-out from LLM cleanup — including at hotkey-fire time. With AI off, the user expects the pasted text to be the raw transcript, not invisibly processed.

User's mental model: **"If the `out` pane is not visible, the pasted text should be whatever is in the `in` pane and not invisibly processed."**

## Approach

The bash side has no DOM access, so the page can't reach the script directly. Instead, mirror the toggle state through the existing `serve.py`:

- `bridge/serve.py` exposes `GET /ai-state` and `POST /ai-state` (text/plain `"0"`/`"1"`), defaulting to `"0"`.
- `web/script.js` POSTs the current state on initial load and on every toggle flip.
- Both send-to-*.sh scripts `curl` the state before the transform step and only call `voiceitt-transform` when it returns `"1"`. Curl failure → default to `"0"` / paste raw (never invisibly process when uncertain).

## Commits

1. `feat(bridge): add GET/POST /ai-state endpoint` — server-only, no behavior change.
2. `feat(web): push AI toggle state to /ai-state` — page-side push, no behavior change yet.
3. `fix(raycast): gate cleanup-at-send on /ai-state` — the actual bug fix.

## Verified automatically

- `python3 -m py_compile bridge/serve.py`
- `bash -n` on both `send-to-*.sh`
- `/ai-state` GET/POST contract against a live `bridge/serve.py` (default → `"0"`; POST `"1"` → ok, GET → `"1"`; POST `"0"` → ok, GET → `"0"`; POST garbage → 400)
- Bash gating logic end-to-end against live server: default → raw, POST `"1"` → transform path, POST `"0"` → raw, server down → raw (default-on-failure).

## Still needs manual Sticky-Keys-ON smoke (per `raycast/AGENTS.md`)

- AI off → dictate → hotkey → confirm raw transcript lands (not LLM-cleaned).
- AI on → dictate → hotkey → confirm cleaned text lands.
- AI on, `GOOGLE_API_KEY` killed mid-flow → confirm fail-open to raw still works.

## Notes

- `bridge/serve.py` is no longer byte-identical with `salvage/bridge/serve.py` (the previously documented invariant). `bridge/AGENTS.md` updated to call this out explicitly rather than letting it rot.
- Last-write-wins across multiple Chrome tabs on the server mirror — acceptable for MVP single-tab workflow.
